_meta.description: Tier 3 — Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR, BEPS Action 13 / Wet Vpb art. 29b-29h) and OESO Pillar Two / GloBE (Wet minimumbelasting 2024). Eight new schemas (GroupEntityRegistry, CbcrJurisdictionSummary, Pillar2JurisdictionComputation, Pillar2SafeHarbour, QdmttReturn, GlobeInformationReturn, CbcrReturn, TaxTreatyOverview). All quantitative logic is declarative (x-openregister-calculations for ETR/SBIE/top-up tax, x-openregister-aggregations for the 7-field CbCR roll-up) per ADR-031 — no GlobeIncomeCalculator.php / QdmttService.php. Lifecycle automation per x-openregister-lifecycle; cross-schema preconditions (QDMTT-priority gate, reconciliation sign-off) delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\CbcrPillar2Guard (ADR-031 exception path). Seed data pre-loads a worked NL/DE FY2026 example group. EUR 750M threshold detection, GloBE 35-item correction audit trail, safe-harbour transitional tests (2024-2026), and OESO CbC/GIR XML export are declared as schema metadata; live XML rendering + SBR/Digipoort submission are openconnector-owned (T4) and DEFERRED — see tasks.md.

GroupEntityRegistry.title: Group Entity Registry
GroupEntityRegistry.description: Constituent entity of a multinational group within the consolidation perimeter (REQ-CBC-002). Holds incorporation + tax-residency jurisdiction, consolidation method/percentage, CbCR/Pillar 2 scope flags, and identification (LEI, VAT). The per-jurisdiction CbCR summary is the sum of all in-scope entities sharing a jurisdiction. A person/owner is a Nextcloud entity (responsibleOwner FK to the NC user directory) — never an invented contact schema.

entityName.description: Legal name of the constituent entity (REQ-CBC-002).

legalForm.description: Legal form, e.g. BV, GmbH, Ltd, Inc.

taxResidency.description: Tax residency jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); may differ from incorporation jurisdiction.

parentEntity.description: FK (self) to the immediate parent GroupEntityRegistry record.

ultimateParentEntity.description: FK (self) to the ultimate parent entity (UPE) of the group.

consolidationPercentage.description: Consolidation percentage — 100 for full consolidation, lower for proportional.

consolidationMethod.description: Consolidation method applied to this entity (design D1; follows the consolidated financial-statement method per Open Question 1).

mainBusinessActivity.description: OESO CbCR main business activity classification (REQ-CBC-002).

cbcrIncluded.description: Whether the entity is included in CbCR aggregation. Set group-wide by the prior-year EUR 750M threshold watcher (REQ-CBC-001) — see x-openregister-threshold-watcher on the UltimateParentEntity record.

pillar2Included.description: Whether the entity is in Pillar 2 scope. Set group-wide by the prior-year EUR 750M threshold watcher (REQ-CBC-001) — see x-openregister-threshold-watcher on the UltimateParentEntity record.

thresholdCrossed.description: UPE-only flag: did the group cross the EUR 750M consolidated-revenue threshold in the prior fiscal year, bringing it into CbCR / Pillar 2 scope for the current period (REQ-CBC-001)? Maintained by the openconnector-owned threshold watcher (see x-openregister-threshold-watcher); read-only for human operators. Null until the watcher first runs; ignored on non-UPE records.

thresholdCrossedAt.description: UPE-only: timestamp at which the threshold watcher first flagged the group as in-scope (REQ-CBC-001). Used for the first-CbCR (12 months after FYE) and first-GIR (18 months) deadline warnings.

excludedEntityType.description: Excluded-entity classification per GloBE Art. 1.5, or 'none' if a regular constituent entity.

firstYearInGroup.description: Date the entity first entered the consolidation perimeter.

responsibleOwner.description: Nextcloud user id responsible for the entity's tax data (FK to NC user directory — a person is an NC entity).

state.description: Lifecycle state of the entity record.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Entity attributes and consolidation details being captured.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Reviewed and approved for inclusion in CbCR / Pillar 2 aggregation.

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Frozen for a filed period. Immutable; changes require a new period record.

lock.label: Lock for filing
lock.description: Freeze the entity once its period is filed.

x-openregister-threshold-watcher.description: EUR 750M prior-year consolidated-revenue threshold watcher for CbCR / Pillar 2 scope (REQ-CBC-001 / BEPS Action 13 / Wet Vpb art. 29b / Wet minimumbelasting 2024). Declarative contract for the openconnector-owned BackgroundJob that runs nightly on a live instance — when the prior-year consolidated revenue (sum of CbcrJurisdictionSummary.totalRevenue across all jurisdictions for the prior period) crosses thresholdEur, the watcher sets UPE.thresholdCrossed=true + UPE.thresholdCrossedAt=now() + UPE.cbcrIncluded=true + UPE.pillar2Included=true on the UltimateParentEntity record, and emits the first-CbCR (12 months after FYE) and first-GIR (18 months) deadline warnings as system notifications.

firstCbcrDeadline.description: Emit first-CbCR filing warning 12 months after the FYE following the threshold-crossing year.

firstGirDeadline.description: Emit first-GIR (GloBE Information Return) filing warning 18 months after the FYE following the threshold-crossing year.

x-openregister-threshold-watcher.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live BackgroundJob ships with the openconnector cron-watcher apply cycle on a live instance.

CbcrJurisdictionSummary.title: CbCR Jurisdiction Summary
CbcrJurisdictionSummary.description: Per-jurisdiction aggregation of the seven mandatory CbCR fields for a fiscal year (REQ-CBC-002). totalRevenue is derived declaratively from unrelated + related party revenue (ADR-031). One summary per jurisdiction per period; the sum of all in-scope GroupEntityRegistry records sharing a jurisdiction. Intra-jurisdiction transactions eliminate; cross-jurisdiction intra-group revenue survives as relatedPartyRevenue.

incomeTaxPaidCash.description: Income tax paid (cash basis) during the period.

statedCapital.description: Stated (share) capital of constituent entities in the jurisdiction.

numberOfEmployees.description: Number of employees (FTE-equivalent) with methodology note.

tangibleAssetsOtherThanCash.description: Net book value of tangible assets other than cash and cash equivalents.

mainBusinessActivities.description: Unique set of main business activities from constituent entities in the jurisdiction.

employeeMethodologyNote.description: Note on the FTE counting methodology used (OESO guidance, Open Question 3).

totalRevenue.description: totalRevenue = unrelatedPartyRevenue + relatedPartyRevenue (REQ-CBC-002 / design D3). Declarative per ADR-031 — no aggregation service.

entityRollup.description: CbCR 7-field roll-up: sum the in-scope GroupEntityRegistry records sharing this jurisdiction into the summary (REQ-CBC-002 / design D3). Intra-jurisdiction transactions eliminate; cross-jurisdiction related-party revenue survives.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Reconciled against the consolidated financial statements (REQ-CBC-010).

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Frozen for the CbCR filing. Immutable.

reconcile.label: Mark reconciled
reconcile.description: Confirm reconciliation to the consolidated P&L; residual > EUR 1M flagged unreconciled.

Pillar2JurisdictionComputation.title: Pillar 2 Jurisdiction Computation
Pillar2JurisdictionComputation.description: Per-jurisdiction GloBE / Pillar 2 computation for a period (REQ-CBC-003..006). GloBE income carries the audit trail of the ~35 OESO corrections in globeIncomeAdjustments; ETR, top-up tax rate, SBIE carve-out, excess profit and top-up tax amount are all derived declaratively (x-openregister-calculations, ADR-031) — no GlobeIncomeCalculator.php. QDMTT/IIR/UTPR allocation captured for the GIR. QDMTT priority over IIR is enforced by the lifecycle guard.

commercialProfitBeforeTax.description: Commercial (accounting) profit before tax — the starting point for GloBE income (REQ-CBC-003).

globeIncomeAdjustments.description: Audit trail of the OESO-prescribed GloBE income corrections (REQ-CBC-003). Each line is signed: a negative amount excludes income, a positive amount adds it back.

type.description: GloBE correction category per OESO Model Rules Art. 3.2-3.5.

coveredTaxAdjustments.description: Adjustments to covered taxes (basis-erosion, DTA effect, etc.).

adjustedCoveredTaxes.description: Adjusted covered taxes (Vpb current + deferred + similar levies with corrections) (REQ-CBC-004).

payroll.description: Eligible payroll costs in the jurisdiction for the SBIE carve-out (REQ-CBC-005).

tangibleAssetsNbv.description: Net book value of eligible tangible assets for the SBIE carve-out (REQ-CBC-005).

carveOutRatePayroll.description: SBIE payroll carve-out percentage for the period (phased 10% in 2023 to 5% in 2033) (REQ-CBC-005).

carveOutRateTangible.description: SBIE tangible-asset carve-out percentage for the period (phased 8% in 2023 to 5% in 2033) (REQ-CBC-005).

qdmttApplicable.description: Whether a Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax applies (NL-resident, ETR < 15%) (REQ-CBC-006).

qdmttAmount.description: Top-up tax levied by the jurisdiction itself via QDMTT (REQ-CBC-006).

iirAmount.description: Top-up tax allocated to the UPE jurisdiction via IIR, net of QDMTT credit (REQ-CBC-006).

utprAmount.description: Top-up tax allocated via the Undertaxed Profits Rule (from FY2024).

safeHarbourApplied.description: Whether a transitional safe harbour replaced the full computation (REQ-CBC-007).

safeHarbourTest.description: Which safe harbour applied and the supporting rationale (REQ-CBC-007).

globeIncomeAdjustmentTotal.description: Sum of all GloBE income corrections (REQ-CBC-003).

globeIncome.description: GloBE income = commercial PBT + sum of corrections (REQ-CBC-003).

etrJurisdiction.description: ETR = adjustedCoveredTaxes / globeIncome, floored at 0 and capped at 1 (REQ-CBC-004).

excessProfit.description: Excess profit = max(0, GloBE income - SBIE) (REQ-CBC-005).

topUpTaxAmount.description: Top-up tax = top-up rate * excess profit (REQ-CBC-004/005).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: GloBE income, corrections, and covered taxes being entered.

computed.label: Computed
computed.description: ETR, SBIE, and top-up tax derived; QDMTT/IIR/UTPR allocation pending.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Reviewed; QDMTT priority enforced before IIR allocation (REQ-CBC-006).

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Frozen for the GIR filing. Immutable.

compute.label: Compute Pillar 2
compute.description: Derive ETR, SBIE, and top-up tax from the declarative calculations.

approve.label: Approve allocation
approve.description: Enforce QDMTT priority over IIR for NL-resident low-taxed income before approval (REQ-CBC-006).

lock.label: Lock for GIR
lock.description: Freeze for the GloBE Information Return.

Pillar2SafeHarbour.title: Pillar 2 Safe Harbour
Pillar2SafeHarbour.description: Transitional CbCR safe harbour test result per jurisdiction per period (REQ-CBC-007). A pass on any of the three tests (de-minimis, simplified-ETR, routine-profits) replaces the full Pillar 2 computation with a simplified return for the period (FY2024-2026 transition window).

testApplied.description: Which transitional safe-harbour test was applied (REQ-CBC-007).

testResult.description: Whether the jurisdiction qualifies for the safe harbour (REQ-CBC-007).

dataSource.description: Data source used for the test (must be a qualified source per OESO guidance).

supportingCalculations.description: Supporting figures for the test (revenue, profit, ETR, SBIE) for the audit trail.

QdmttReturn.title: QDMTT Return
QdmttReturn.description: Dutch Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax return for an NL-resident entity (REQ-CBC-006, Wet minimumbelasting 2024). QDMTT is levied in NL before any foreign IIR claim. XML/XBRL submission to the Belastingdienst via SBR/Digipoort is openconnector-owned (T4) and DEFERRED; this schema captures the filing record + status.

entity.description: FK to the NL-resident GroupEntityRegistry record (REQ-CBC-006).

taxableGlobeIncome.description: GloBE income subject to QDMTT (after SBIE).

qualifyingDomesticEtr.description: Domestic ETR used for the QDMTT computation.

belastingdienstReference.description: Belastingdienst submission reference (placeholder until SBR submission, T4).

xbrlSubmission.description: FK to the generated XBRL submission file (openconnector-owned export, T4 DEFERRED).

resubmit.label: Reopen for correction
resubmit.description: Return to draft to correct and resubmit.

GlobeInformationReturn.title: GloBE Information Return
GlobeInformationReturn.description: GIR for a group for a period (REQ-CBC-009). References all per-jurisdiction Pillar 2 computations and carries the top-up tax allocation (IIR/UTPR/QDMTT credit per entity). The OESO GIR XML schema export + validation is openconnector-owned (T4) and DEFERRED; this schema is the data-merge source.

ultimateParent.description: FK to the UPE GroupEntityRegistry record (REQ-CBC-009).

globeXmlSubmission.description: FK to the generated GIR XML file (openconnector-owned export, T4 DEFERRED — see x-openregister-export-target on this schema for the renderer contract).

submissionDeadline.description: Filing deadline (15 months after FYE; 18 months for the first year).

x-openregister-export-target.description: OESO GloBE Information Return (GIR) XML export contract (REQ-CBC-009). Declarative contract for the openconnector-owned XML renderer that generates the OESO GIR XML on lifecycle transition `submit` (approved → submitted). Data is merged from `globe-information-return` + `pillar2-jurisdiction-computation` + `pillar2-safe-harbour` records; the rendered XML is stored to `globeXmlSubmission` (FileService FK); the renderer validates against the OESO GIR XML schema before export.

renderSections.section1MneGroupSummary: Group identification + ultimate parent + perimeter + filing constituent (from @self.ultimateParent + @self.mneGroupSummary).
renderSections.section2PerJurisdiction: Per-jurisdiction ETR + GloBE income + SBIE + top-up tax for each Pillar2JurisdictionComputation record (REQ-CBC-004/005); safe-harbour shortcut emitted when Pillar2SafeHarbour.testResult=pass for the jurisdiction (REQ-CBC-007).
renderSections.section3TopUpTaxAllocation: IIR + UTPR + QDMTT distribution per entity (REQ-CBC-006/009) sourced from @self.topUpTaxAllocation.

x-openregister-export-target.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live OESO-GIR-XML renderer + schema validator + jurisdiction-specific submission adapter ship with the openconnector gir-xml apply cycle on a live instance.

CbcrReturn.title: CbCR Return
CbcrReturn.description: CbCR report in the OESO CbC schema for a group for a period (REQ-CBC-008). References the jurisdiction summaries and the constituent-entity list, and carries the mandatory reconciliation to the consolidated financial statements (REQ-CBC-010). OESO CbC XML v2.0 export + SBR submission is openconnector-owned (T4) and DEFERRED.

reportingEntity.description: FK to the reporting GroupEntityRegistry record (REQ-CBC-008).

reconciliationResidual.description: Residual difference between CbCR totals and the consolidated P&L (REQ-CBC-010).

reconciliationUnreconciled.description: Computed: residual > EUR 1M is flagged unreconciled (REQ-CBC-010).

reconciliationItems.description: Explained reconciliation items (JV pro-rata, eliminations, IFRS-USGAAP).

cbcrXmlSubmission.description: FK to the generated CbCR XML file (openconnector-owned export, T4 DEFERRED — see x-openregister-export-target on this schema for the renderer contract).

mcaaPartnerJurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions the report is automatically exchanged with under the MCAA.

reconciliationUnreconciled.description: Residual difference greater than EUR 1M is flagged unreconciled (REQ-CBC-010).

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Reconciled to the consolidated financial statements (REQ-CBC-010).

reconcile.label: Mark reconciled
reconcile.description: Confirm reconciliation; residual > EUR 1M must be explained before sign-off (REQ-CBC-010).

x-openregister-export-target.description: OESO CbCR XML v2.0 export contract (REQ-CBC-008). Declarative contract for the openconnector-owned XML renderer that generates the OESO Country-by-Country Report XML on lifecycle transition `submit` (reconciled → submitted). Data is merged from `cbcr-return` + `cbcr-jurisdiction-summary` + `group-entity-registry` records; the rendered XML is stored to `cbcrXmlSubmission` (FileService FK); the SBR/Digipoort submission token returned by the Belastingdienst is stored to `belastingdienstReference`.

renderSections.messageSpec: Group identification, sender, reporting period, message type code (CBC401 new, CBC402 correction).
renderSections.docSpec: Document reference id, document type indicator (OECD1 new, OECD2 correction, OECD3 deletion).
renderSections.cbcReports: Per-jurisdiction Summary block (7 CbCR fields) + ConstEntities block (one per GroupEntityRegistry record in scope).

x-openregister-export-target.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live OESO-CBC-XML renderer + Digipoort submission adapter ship with the openconnector cbcr-xml apply cycle on a live instance.

TaxTreatyOverview.title: Tax Treaty Overview
TaxTreatyOverview.description: Reference register of double-taxation agreements (DTAs) used when allocating withholding taxes to jurisdictions within adjusted covered taxes (REQ-CBC-004). Reference data only; no lifecycle.

treatyDate.description: Date the treaty entered into force.

withholdingRates.description: Withholding rates by income type (dividends, interest, royalties).

mliApplicability.description: Whether the Multilateral Instrument (MLI) applies to this treaty.

objects.employeeMethodologyNote: FTE-equivalent at period close per OESO guidance.
FTE-equivalent at period close per OESO guidance.

globeIncomeAdjustments.description: Participation-exemption dividends excluded from GloBE income.
